questions.question: Explain why 3 rotis shared equally among 4 children gives each child three quarters of a roti.
questions.expected_answer: Cut each roti into 4 quarters, making 12 quarters altogether. Share the 12 quarters among 4 children: each child gets 3 quarters. So 3 divided by 4 is three quarters.

questions.question: Find 1/4 of 20 and 3/4 of 20, and explain the rule you used.
questions.expected_answer: One quarter of 20 is 20 divided by 4, which is 5. Three quarters is 3 of those groups, 3 times 5, which is 15. The rule is divide by the bottom number, then multiply by the top number.

questions.question: Share 10 loaves of bread equally among 4 families and explain what happens to the loaves left over.
questions.expected_answer: Each family gets 2 whole loaves, using 8, with 2 loaves left over. The 2 left-over loaves are shared among 4 families, so each family gets two quarters, which is one half. Each family gets 2 and a half loaves.
